variables.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Explicit frontend origin(s) allowed by the API.
variables.failure_message: Set ALLOWED_ORIGINS to the deployed frontend origin.

variables.name: MARKETOS_MVP_MODE
variables.description: MVP profile marker; use 1 only after server configuration review.
variables.failure_message: Set MARKETOS_MVP_MODE=1 for a deployed MVP profile.

variables.name: MARKETOS_EVENT_READ_JSONL_PATH
variables.description: Server-side canonical event artifact read path.
variables.failure_message: Set a read path beneath artifacts/ for operator event views.

variables.name: MARKETOS_EVENT_WRITE_JSONL_PATH
variables.failure_message: Set a write path beneath artifacts/ before enabling event-target jsonl.

variables.name: MARKETOS_PUBLIC_SIGNAL_CACHE_DIR
variables.description: Local cache directory for bounded public RSS observations.
variables.failure_message: Use a cache directory beneath artifacts/.

variables.name: MARKETOS_PUBLIC_COMMERCE_RUNS
variables.description: Server gate for manually invoked public Commerce MVP API runs.
variables.failure_message: Keep 0 until public-run deployment review is complete.

variables.name: MARKETOS_PUBLIC_RUN_RATE_LIMIT
variables.failure_message: Keep the bounded default or use a reviewed lower value.

variables.name: MARKETOS_PUBLIC_RUN_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS
variables.failure_message: Use a finite window; distributed protection is deferred.

variables.name: MARKETOS_EVENT_READ_RATE_LIMIT
variables.failure_message: Keep the bounded default or use a reviewed lower value.

variables.name: MARKETOS_EVENT_READ_RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS
variables.description: Canonical-event read rate-limit window in seconds.
variables.failure_message: Use a finite window; distributed protection is deferred.

variables.name: MARKETOS_SUPABASE_CANONICAL_EVENTS
variables.failure_message: Keep 0 unless server-only staging configuration is approved.

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.failure_message: Provide only to the backend when staging persistence is approved.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.failure_message: Never place this in VITE_* variables or frontend files.

variables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.description: Existing optional Supabase anon key; never used for server event writes.
variables.failure_message: Do not expose Supabase credentials through the browser.

variables.name: SENTRY_DSN
variables.failure_message: Configure only through the server host.

variables.name: SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT
variables.failure_message: Use a non-sensitive deployment label.

variables.name: SENTRY_RELEASE
variables.failure_message: Use a non-sensitive build identifier.

variables.name: SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE
variables.description: Optional bounded Sentry performance sample rate.
variables.failure_message: Keep the sample rate low and review telemetry cost.

variables.name: POSTHOG_PROJECT_API_KEY
variables.failure_message: Do not confuse this with the public VITE_POSTHOG_KEY.

variables.name: VITE_API_BASE_URL
variables.description: Public base URL for the FastAPI read/operator API.
variables.failure_message: Set to the deployed backend URL in Vercel.

variables.name: VITE_POSTHOG_KEY
variables.description: Optional public PostHog browser key already supported by the frontend.
variables.failure_message: Leave empty unless browser telemetry is intentionally enabled.

variables.name: VITE_POSTHOG_HOST
variables.failure_message: Use the existing PostHog host convention.
